outcome: postpartum readmission for preeclampsia with severe features
cohort: Adult parturients, including those readmitted for preeclampsia with severe features and matched nonreadmitted controls, were included in the study.
finding: Elevated mean arterial pressure (MAP) at admission and 24-hour postpartum, along with African American race and a history of hypertensive disorder of pregnancy, were independently associated with an increased risk of postpartum readmission for preeclampsia with severe features.
